description: This file defines a plugin class for the TestLink system, specifically a sample plugin named TLTestPlugin. It extends the base class TestlinkPlugin and registers various hooks for test management events, and defines functions related to test suite creation, project creation/update, test case updates, requirement management, test execution, and custom UI links.

classes.name: TLTestPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for TestLink that registers itself with various hooks and provides UI elements and logging for test management events.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers plugin details such as name, description, version, author, contact, and URL.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Returns configuration options for the plugin.

methods.name: hooks
methods.description: Registers event hooks to handle various test management events.

methods.name: testsuite_create
methods.description: Handles the event of creating a test suite, logs a message.

methods.name: testproject_create
methods.description: Logs information upon test project creation.

methods.name: testproject_update
methods.description: Logs information upon test project update.

methods.name: testcase_update
methods.description: Logs details when a test case is updated.

methods.name: testrequirement_create
methods.description: Logs creation of a test requirement.

methods.name: testrequirement_update
methods.description: Logs update of a test requirement.

methods.name: testrequirement_delete
methods.description: Logs deletion of a test requirement.

methods.name: testExecute
methods.description: Logs details when a test run is executed.

methods.name: testrun_display_block
methods.description: Returns an HTML image tag representing a test run display.

methods.name: bottom_link
methods.description: Provides a bottom link for the UI.

methods.name: top_link
methods.description: Provides a top link for configuration.

methods.name: right_top_link
methods.description: Provides a right top link for the UI.

methods.name: right_bottom_link
methods.description: Provides a right bottom link for the UI.
